text: Which planet takes about 88 Earth days to go around the Sun?
explanation: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun and has the shortest year.
attribution: Original wording by HiMorning. Factual reference: NASA Science · https://science.nasa.gov/mercury/facts/

text: Which planet has the hottest surface in the solar system?
explanation: Venus has a thick atmosphere that traps heat.
attribution: Original wording by HiMorning. Factual reference: NASA Science · https://science.nasa.gov/resource/solar-system-temperatures/

text: Jupiter spins once in about 10 hours. Earth takes 24 hours. Where is a day shorter?
explanation: A day here means one full spin. Jupiter takes less than half as long as Earth.
attribution: Original wording by HiMorning. Factual reference: NASA Science · https://science.nasa.gov/jupiter/jupiter-facts/

text: Which of these moons is bigger than the planet Mercury?
explanation: Ganymede, which orbits Jupiter, is the largest moon in the solar system.
attribution: Original wording by HiMorning. Factual reference: NASA Science · https://science.nasa.gov/jupiter/jupiter-moons/ganymede/facts/

text: Which planet spins almost on its side as it orbits the Sun?
explanation: Uranus’s axis is tilted so far that the planet appears to roll around the Sun.
attribution: Original wording by HiMorning. Factual reference: NASA Science · https://science.nasa.gov/uranus/facts/

text: A model shows Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune in order from the Sun. Which sits between Saturn and Neptune?
explanation: Uranus is one place farther from the Sun than Saturn and one closer than Neptune.
attribution: Original wording by HiMorning. Factual reference: NASA Science · https://science.nasa.gov/solar-system/planets/

text: Titan has lakes of liquid methane. Which planet does it orbit?
explanation: Titan is a moon of Saturn, and its lakes are made of hydrocarbons.
attribution: Original wording by HiMorning. Factual reference: NASA Science · https://science.nasa.gov/saturn/facts/

text: Which of these is a rocky planet?
explanation: Mars is one of the four rocky planets closest to the Sun.
attribution: Original wording by HiMorning. Factual reference: NASA Science · https://science.nasa.gov/solar-system/solar-system-facts/

text: Which ocean is both the largest and the deepest?
explanation: The Pacific is larger and deeper than any other ocean basin.
attribution: Original wording by HiMorning. Factual reference: NOAA · https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/biggestocean.html

text: How many hearts does an octopus have?
explanation: Two send blood to the gills. The third sends it around the body.
attribution: Original wording by HiMorning. Factual reference: NOAA · https://www.noaa.gov/stories/love-is-in-air-and-sea-5-facts-about-affections-of-marine-creatures

text: A coral reef looks like a garden. What are the corals themselves?
explanation: Corals are made up of tiny animals called polyps.
attribution: Original wording by HiMorning. Factual reference: NOAA · https://oceanexplorer.noaa.gov/ocean-fact/coral-animal/

text: A tide chart follows the pull of the Moon and the Sun. What force is it tracking?
explanation: The gravitational pull of the Moon and Sun sets the tides in motion.
attribution: Original wording by HiMorning. Factual reference: NOAA · https://www.noaa.gov/education/resource-collections/ocean-coasts/tides

text: The 7:40 express train zooms right past Hill Station without stopping, while the 7:48 commuter train stops at every platform, including Hill Station. Your morning coffee meetup is right outside Hill Station. Which train gets you to your coffee?
explanation: A faster train does not help if it skips your stop; only the 7:48 train actually lets you off at Hill Station.

text: Your borrowed design book is due on Tuesday. A sign on the library door says: “Main reading room closed Tuesday for floor waxing; 24-hour outdoor return drop stays open.” Can you still return the book on time on Tuesday?
choices: Yes, by sliding it into the outdoor return drop
No, you must wait until Wednesday morning
Only if you bring a library staff key
explanation: The outdoor return drop stays open 24 hours even while the reading room inside is closed.

text: Minh texts you: “Leave my gym bag at the front desk unless I message you a new plan before 8:00.” It is now 8:05 and your phone has zero new messages from Minh. Where does the bag go?
choices: Back in your closet at home
explanation: Since Minh never sent a new message before 8:00, the original plan to leave it at the front desk stands.

text: A French toast recipe says: “Whisk 2 eggs with milk to make 4 thick slices.” You are only cooking breakfast for yourself and want 2 slices. How many eggs do you whisk?
explanation: Making half the slices (2 instead of 4) uses half the eggs: one egg.

text: The indie cinema ticket stub reads: “Before 8:00 p.m. enter through the lobby café (Door A). After 8:00 p.m. the café locks up—please use the courtyard gate (Door B).” You arrive at 8:10 p.m. Which entrance works?
explanation: At 8:10 p.m. the café entrance is already locked, so you use Door B in the courtyard.

text: Two shady trails wind up to the lakeside pavilion. The Lakeside Loop allows bicycles and joggers, while the Bamboo Footpath is strictly for walkers on foot. You are riding your bike this morning. Which trail can you take?
explanation: Only the Lakeside Loop permits bicycles; the Bamboo Footpath is foot-traffic only.

text: Your sock drawer holds 10 black socks and 10 white socks mixed together. In the pitch-dark bedroom at 6:00 a.m., what is the smallest number of socks you must grab to be 100% sure you have a matching pair?
explanation: With only two colors, the first two socks might be one black and one white, so the third sock is guaranteed to match one of them.

text: A rooster perches right on the sharp peak of a barn roof facing north. If it lays an egg at sunrise, which side of the roof does the egg roll down?
explanation: Hens lay eggs; roosters never lay eggs no matter which way the roof slopes.

text: In a morning park sprint, you put on a burst of speed and overtake the runner in second place. What place are you in right now?
explanation: When you pass the person in second place, you take their second-place spot—the first-place leader is still ahead of you.

text: You boil one ostrich egg in a big pot of water, and it takes 40 minutes to cook through. If you put two ostrich eggs into the same big pot of boiling water at the same time, how long do they take?
explanation: Both eggs boil together in the pot at the same time, so they finish in 40 minutes.

text: You speak my name out loud in a quiet library, and the very instant you say it, I am broken. What am I?
explanation: The moment you make a sound to say “silence,” the silence itself is broken.

text: A community animal shelter posts: “We are overflowing with warm blankets, but we urgently need clean cotton towels for bath day.” You have room in your tote bag for one donation. What helps them today?
explanation: They already have plenty of blankets and specifically asked for clean towels.
